data: Which of the following configurations of RNN, word embedding, and ATT achieve a F1 score above 0.7 at least once during training?

The question asks which configuration of RNN, word embedding, and ATT achieves an F1 score above 0.7 at least once during training. From the caption, we can see three different configurations represented by different colored lines in the graph:

1. Red line: RNN + dynamic word embedding + 2ATT
2. Green dashed line: RNN + dynamic word embedding + ATT
3. Blue dotted line: RNN + static word embedding + 2ATT

From the graph, we can observe that all three configurations have their respective lines crossing the 0.7 mark at some point during training. Therefore, all three configurations achieve an F1 score above 0.7 at least once during training.
